tasks.title: Announcement #28
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement on a campus radio station.
tasks.transcript: Man: Environmentally minded students will be happy to know that compost collection bins have been placed next to every paper and plastic recycling receptacle in the student center food court. Now, any uneaten food can be placed into a compost bin. The contents of the bins are collected daily by agriculture students who are transforming our food waste into plant food through the process of composting. Please do your part to keep our campus sustainable through recycling and composting.

questions.stem: According to the talk, what do agriculture students do each day?

options.A: Place composting bins around the campus
options.B: Water plants at the student center
options.C: Recruit volunteers for a recycling program
options.D: Empty the contents of compost containers

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问农学专业的学生每天做什么，属于细节理解题，需抓住男士对农学学生工作的具体描述。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 通知中说堆肥箱已经放置好，并未说明农学学生每天去放置箱子，属于张冠李戴。 选项B：错误。 通知中提到农学学生将食物垃圾转化为植物养料，但并未说明他们每天给学生中心的植物浇水，属于无中生有。 选项C：错误。 通知中没有提到招募志愿者，属于与原文无关的干扰项。 选项D：正确。 男士明确说“The contents of the bins are collected daily by agriculture students who are transforming our food waste into plant food through the process of composting.” 指明这些专业的学生会收走垃圾然后分解之后做成plant food植物养料。

questions.stem: What should be placed in the new bins?
questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问什么东西应该放进新箱子里，属于细节理解题，需抓住男士对堆肥箱用途的明确说明。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 通知中提到纸张和塑料回收容器旁边放置了堆肥箱，但塑料瓶应放入塑料回收容器，而非堆肥箱。 选项B：错误。 纸张应放入纸张回收容器，而非堆肥箱。 选项C：正确。 男士明确说“any uneaten food can be placed into a compost bin”，即任何未吃完的食物都应放入堆肥箱。 选项D：错误。 通知中没有提到金属罐，属于无中生有。
